questions.q: What is an attribute in HTML?
questions.qAf: Wat is 'n attribuut in HTML?
options: Extra information inside the opening tag, written name="value"
A tag that closes another tag
optionsAf: Ekstra inligting binne die openingsetiket, geskryf as name="value"
questions.explain: For example : src is the attribute and "robot.png" its value.
questions.explainAf: Byvoorbeeld : src is die attribuut en "robot.png" sy waarde.

questions.q: Which code sets the background of the whole page to light blue?
questions.qAf: Watter kode stel die agtergrond van die hele bladsy op ligblou?
questions.explain: The bgcolor attribute on <body> sets the page's background colour.
questions.explainAf: Die bgcolor-attribuut op <body> stel die bladsy se agtergrondkleur.

questions.q: Which tag sets text size and colour but is deprecated?
questions.qAf: Watter etiket stel teksgrootte en -kleur, maar is verouderd?
questions.explain: <font> sets size and colour but is deprecated (outdated); in code colour is spelt color.
questions.explainAf: <font> stel grootte en kleur, maar is verouderd; in kode word kleur as color gespel.

questions.q: In a CSS declaration, what ends each property : value pair?
questions.qAf: Wat beëindig elke eienskap : waarde-paar in 'n CSS-deklarasie?
questions.explain: The semicolon is the declaration separator, e.g. color: blue;.
questions.explainAf: Die kommapunt is die deklarasieskeier, bv. color: blue;.

questions.q: Cells hold: 12, Absent, 15, (empty), 9. What does =COUNT give for these five cells?
questions.qAf: Selle bevat: 12, Afwesig, 15, (leeg), 9. Wat gee =COUNT vir hierdie vyf selle?
questions.explain: COUNT counts only cells with numbers: 12, 15 and 9. COUNTA would give 4 and COUNTBLANK 1.
questions.explainAf: COUNT tel net selle met getalle: 12, 15 en 9. COUNTA sou 4 gee en COUNTBLANK 1.

questions.q: In Excel, what is a workbook?
questions.qAf: Wat is 'n werkboek in Excel?
options: The whole file, which holds the worksheets
optionsAf: Die hele lêer, wat die werkblaaie bevat
questions.explain: A workbook is the whole file (the container, like a binder); a worksheet is one page inside it.
questions.explainAf: 'n Werkboek is die hele lêer (die houer, soos 'n lêer met bladsye); 'n werkblad is een bladsy daarin.

questions.q: The class plans a fun day by splitting it into food, games and tickets. Which pillar of computational thinking is this?
questions.qAf: Die klas beplan 'n prettige dag deur dit in kos, speletjies en kaartjies op te deel. Watter pilaar van berekeningsdenke is dit?
questions.explain: Decomposition breaks a complex problem down into smaller, manageable parts.
questions.explainAf: Ontbinding breek 'n komplekse probleem in kleiner, hanteerbare dele op.

questions.q: What makes it possible for the same Java program to run on Windows, Mac and Android?
questions.qAf: Wat maak dit moontlik dat dieselfde Java-program op Windows, Mac en Android loop?
questions.explain: Java is cross-platform: each device has its own JVM that runs the .class file.
questions.explainAf: Java is kruisplatform: elke toestel het sy eie JVM wat die .class-lêer uitvoer.

questions.q: A 9 V battery powers an LED that drops 2 V. The current must be 14 mA (0.014 A). Which resistor is needed?
questions.qAf: 'n 9 V-battery dryf 'n LED met 'n spanningsval van 2 V. Die stroom moet 14 mA (0,014 A) wees. Watter resistor is nodig?
questions.explain: The resistor takes 9 − 2 = 7 V. R = V ÷ I = 7 ÷ 0.014 = 500 Ω.
questions.explainAf: Die resistor neem 9 − 2 = 7 V. R = V ÷ I = 7 ÷ 0,014 = 500 Ω.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: The alt text of an image helps blind users.
questions.qAf: Die alt-teks van 'n prent help blinde gebruikers.
questions.explain: alt is alternative text for blind users, and it also shows if the image fails to load.
questions.explainAf: alt is alternatiewe teks vir blinde gebruikers, en dit wys ook as die prent nie laai nie.

questions.q: A CSS class may be used only once on a page.
questions.qAf: 'n CSS-klas mag net een keer op 'n bladsy gebruik word.
questions.explain: A class is reusable; an ID is the one used once per page.
questions.explainAf: 'n Klas is herbruikbaar; 'n ID is die een wat een keer per bladsy gebruik word.

questions.q: AutoFill can fill a series such as Mon, Tue, Wed.
questions.qAf: AutoFill kan 'n reeks soos Mon, Tue, Wed vul.
questions.explain: Dragging the Fill Handle fills a series from a built-in list (Mon → Tue, Jan → Feb, 1 → 2).
questions.explainAf: As jy die vulhandvatsel sleep, word 'n reeks uit 'n ingeboude lys gevul (Mon → Tue, Jan → Feb, 1 → 2).

questions.q: The columns of a spreadsheet are labelled with numbers.
questions.qAf: Die kolomme van 'n sigblad word met getalle benoem.
questions.explain: Columns are vertical and labelled with letters; rows are horizontal and labelled with numbers.
questions.explainAf: Kolomme is vertikaal en word met letters benoem; rye is horisontaal en word met getalle benoem.

questions.q: In Java, every opening brace { needs a closing brace }.
questions.qAf: In Java het elke openingskrulhakie { 'n sluitende krulhakie } nodig.
questions.explain: Braces mark where a block of code begins and ends.
questions.explainAf: Krulhakies wys waar 'n blok kode begin en eindig.

questions.q: A fully constrained sketch has zero degrees of freedom.
questions.qAf: 'n Volledig beperkte skets het nul vryheidsgrade.
questions.explain: Zero DOF: the sketch turns green and cannot shift by accident.
questions.explainAf: Nul DOF: die skets word groen en kan nie per ongeluk skuif nie.

questions.q: An ammeter is connected in parallel.
questions.qAf: 'n Ammeter word in parallel gekoppel.
questions.explain: An ammeter measures current and goes in series; a voltmeter goes in parallel.
questions.explainAf: 'n Ammeter meet stroom en gaan in serie; 'n voltmeter gaan in parallel.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each FreeCAD constraint in column A with its effect in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke FreeCAD-beperking in kolom A by sy effek in kolom B.
pairs: Two lines run in the same direction, like railway tracks
Two points mirror each other around an axis, like butterfly wings
Sets the angle of a line relative to an axis or another line
Fixes a point with a horizontal and a vertical constraint at once
pairsAf: Twee lyne loop in dieselfde rigting, soos spoorlyne
Twee punte is spieëlbeelde van mekaar om 'n as, soos skoenlappervlerke
Stel die hoek van 'n lyn relatief tot 'n as of 'n ander lyn
Maak 'n punt vas met 'n horisontale en 'n vertikale beperking gelyktydig
extra: Sets the exact length of a line
extraAf: Stel die presiese lengte van 'n lyn
questions.explain: The extra description in column B is the distance constraint.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing in kolom B is die afstandbeperking.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each part of the Arduino Uno to what it does.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke deel van die Arduino Uno aan wat dit doen.
pairs: Stores the program, even when the power is off
Stores variables only while the program runs
The USB port used to load a program
Prints readings on the computer screen for debugging
pairsAf: Stoor die program, selfs wanneer die krag af is
Stoor veranderlikes net terwyl die program loop
Die USB-poort wat gebruik word om 'n program te laai
Druk lesings op die rekenaarskerm vir ontfouting
questions.explain: Flash memory is non-volatile (32 KB); SRAM is volatile (2 KB).
questions.explainAf: Flitsgeheue is nie-vlugtig (32 KB); SRAM is vlugtig (2 KB).

questions.q: Match each way of writing a colour in CSS in column A with an example in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke manier om 'n kleur in CSS te skryf in kolom A by 'n voorbeeld in kolom B.
questions.explain: The extra example in column B is a CSS comment, not a colour.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra voorbeeld in kolom B is 'n CSS-kommentaar, nie 'n kleur nie.

sections.title: Steps in order
sections.intro: Put the steps in the correct order.
sections.introAf: Plaas die stappe in die korrekte volgorde.

questions.q: Put the lines of a program that makes a Gogga move 5 times in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die reëls van 'n program wat 'n Gogga 5 keer laat beweeg, in die korrekte volgorde.
questions.explain: Import the Gogga class, create the object with new, then the loop, then the command it repeats.
questions.explainAf: Voer die Gogga-klas in (import), skep die objek met new, dan die lus, dan die opdrag wat dit herhaal.

questions.q: Put the steps for finding the centre of a 60 mm object with construction lines in the correct order.
questions.qAf: Plaas die stappe om die middel van 'n 60 mm-voorwerp met konstruksielyne te vind, in die korrekte volgorde.
steps: Draw a construction line from the origin
Add a distance constraint of 30 mm (60 ÷ 2)
Draw a second construction line perpendicular (90°) to the first
stepsAf: Teken 'n tweede konstruksielyn loodreg (90°) op die eerste
questions.explain: Construction mode first, so the lines are blue guides that never become part of the model.
questions.explainAf: Eers konstruksiemodus, sodat die lyne blou hulplyne is wat nooit deel van die model word nie.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Pieter styles the lab rules page. This is his CSS and HTML:
questions.scenarioAf: Pieter stileer die laboratoriumreëls-bladsy. Dit is sy CSS en HTML:

questions.q: What colour is the heading Lab Rules?
questions.qAf: Watter kleur is die opskrif Lab Rules?
questions.explain: The h1 rule sets every <h1> to blue.
questions.explainAf: Die h1-reël stel elke <h1> op blou.

questions.q: What colour is the text Listen to the teacher?
questions.qAf: Watter kleur is die teks Listen to the teacher?
questions.explain: That paragraph has id="rule1", and #rule1 sets #00FF00, which is green.
questions.explainAf: Daardie paragraaf het id="rule1", en #rule1 stel #00FF00, wat groen is.

questions.q: In font-size: 300%;, what is font-size?
questions.qAf: Wat is font-size in font-size: 300%;?
questions.explain: A declaration is property : value pairs; font-size is the property and 300% the value.
questions.explainAf: 'n Deklarasie is eienskap : waarde-pare; font-size is die eienskap en 300% die waarde.

questions.q: This CSS should be saved in a separate .css file and linked in the <head>.
questions.qAf: Hierdie CSS moet in 'n aparte .css-lêer gestoor en in die <head> gekoppel word.
questions.explain: External CSS is the preferred method: one file can style many pages.
questions.explainAf: Eksterne CSS is die voorkeurmetode: een lêer kan baie bladsye stileer.

questions.scenario: A teacher has the marks of 25 learners in C2:C26.
questions.scenarioAf: 'n Onderwyser het die punte van 25 leerders in C2:C26.

questions.q: Which formula gives the class average?
questions.qAf: Watter formule gee die klasgemiddelde?
questions.explain: AVERAGE of the whole range gives the mean. =AVERAGE(C2,C26) uses only the two cells C2 and C26.
questions.explainAf: AVERAGE van die hele reeks gee die gemiddelde. =AVERAGE(C2,C26) gebruik net die twee selle C2 en C26.

questions.q: Which formula finds the top mark?
questions.qAf: Watter formule vind die hoogste punt?
questions.explain: MAX gives the largest value in the range.
questions.explainAf: MAX gee die grootste waarde in die reeks.

questions.q: She wants marks above 80 to turn green automatically. Which tool should she use?
questions.qAf: Sy wil hê punte bo 80 moet outomaties groen word. Watter hulpmiddel moet sy gebruik?
questions.explain: Conditional formatting changes how a cell looks when its value meets a rule, e.g. greater than 80.
questions.explainAf: Voorwaardelike formatering verander hoe 'n sel lyk wanneer sy waarde aan 'n reël voldoen, bv. groter as 80.

questions.q: She sorts the marks from highest to lowest. Which order is that?
questions.qAf: Sy sorteer die punte van hoogste na laagste. Watter volgorde is dit?
questions.explain: Highest to lowest is descending; lowest to highest is ascending.
questions.explainAf: Hoogste na laagste is dalend; laagste na hoogste is stygend.

questions.scenario: Lindiwe builds a doorbell in TinkerCAD: a pushbutton on a digital pin, and a piezo buzzer that sounds when the button is pressed.
questions.scenarioAf: Lindiwe bou 'n deurklokkie in TinkerCAD: 'n drukknoppie op 'n digitale pen, en 'n piëzo-zoemer wat lui wanneer die knoppie gedruk word.

questions.q: What is the pushbutton?
questions.qAf: Wat is die drukknoppie?
questions.explain: A pushbutton is a digital input: when pressed it connects the two sides of the circuit.
questions.explainAf: 'n Drukknoppie is 'n digitale inset: wanneer dit gedruk word, verbind dit die twee kante van die stroombaan.

questions.q: In the IPO cycle, what is the buzzer?
questions.qAf: Wat is die zoemer in die IPO-siklus?
questions.explain: The buzzer acts on the world by making sound, so it is an output.
questions.explainAf: Die zoemer werk op die wêreld in deur klank te maak, dus is dit 'n uitset.

questions.q: How does a piezo buzzer make sound?
questions.qAf: Hoe maak 'n piëzo-zoemer klank?
options: An electric current makes a crystal vibrate
questions.explain: An electric current makes a piezo-electric crystal vibrate, which makes sound.
questions.explainAf: 'n Elektriese stroom laat 'n piëso-elektriese kristal vibreer, wat klank maak.

questions.q: Which two states can a digital pin have?
questions.qAf: Watter twee toestande kan 'n digitale pen hê?
questions.explain: A digital pin is either HIGH (5 V) or LOW (0 V).
questions.explainAf: 'n Digitale pen is óf HIGH (5 V) óf LOW (0 V).

questions.q: Components in TinkerCAD can burn out, so you must test very carefully.
questions.qAf: Komponente in TinkerCAD kan uitbrand, dus moet jy baie versigtig toets.
questions.explain: TinkerCAD is a simulator: nothing can burn out. Real components can, though.
questions.explainAf: TinkerCAD is 'n simulator: niks kan uitbrand nie. Regte komponente kan egter.
